_order_comment: Grouped by family, not interleaved: Quakes (chronological), then the HarbourMasters N64 ports (the two Zeldas first, the rest by original release), then the one-offs, with Apotris deliberately last on both platforms. Note this list doubles as the shop window — with no `featured` block, AltStore/SideStore fall back to the apps array and stock clients still cap the source page at the first 5, so the leading five here (three Quakes + the two Zeldas) are all a stock-client user sees without tapping through.

ios.name: rebelancap Ports — iPhone & iPad
ios.subtitle: Native game ports for iPhone & iPad
ios.description: Every rebelancap game port that runs on iPhone and iPad — Quake, the HarbourMasters N64 ports, and more, all running natively on Metal. Each app ships with no game content; you supply your own game data.
